profile.name: Reagan Munene
profile.title: Full-Stack Engineer & Founder
profile.tagline: I build software people actually run their businesses on.
about: Fourth-year Business Information Technology student at Kabarak University, and founder of ZERION TECH SYSTEMS — a software company building platforms for SACCOs, hospitality, and enterprise operations.

I work end to end: React and React Native on the front, Node.js, Express, NestJS, and Supabase on the back, with deployment on Render, Vercel, and Cloudflare. Recent work includes Signvrse Ltd (assistive tech and KSL tooling) and shipping Z Crew App, Z Management Hub, Z REST POS, and Zerion ERP into daily use.
I learn fast, ship without babysitting, and care about accessibility, operational clarity, and financial accountability in the systems I leave behind.

experience.summary: Design and ship industry platforms for transport SACCOs, food service, and enterprise clients — from product architecture to deployment.
highlights: Built Z Crew App with Z Booking and Parcel Shop for Chuka Ungwana Sacco
Shipped Z Management Hub for SACCO admin, fleet, finance, and route performance
Delivered Z REST POS for hotels and restaurants, including The Duos Kitchen
Architecting Zerion ERP for private companies and government agencies

experience.summary: Full-stack engineering on accessibility-focused products converting speech and text into Kenyan Sign Language experiences.
highlights: Built React.js features and Node/Express/NestJS services
Worked with durable workflows, video rendering, and sign-language stitching
Prepared 3D assets (FBX → GLB) and cleaned animations in iClone
Deployed with Cloudflare and added JWT token-bucket API rate limiting

experience.summary: Supported executive operations on a Forex education platform — organisation, communication, and follow-through on strategic work.
Designed web applications while coordinating timelines and tasks in Jira to meet client requirements.
Full-stack web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Diagnosed, upgraded, and repaired laptops and desktop systems at component level.
